headline: Avantor Stock Surged Because One Segment Stopped Shrinking
summary: Organic revenue still fell, yet a segment returning to growth and a raised outlook were enough to reprice the stock in a single session.

headline: The Top 5 Analyst Questions From Thermo Fisher’s Q2 Earnings Call
summary: Thermo Fisher’s second quarter saw a notable uptick in end-market activity, propelling results above Wall Street’s expectations and leading to a positive market reaction.
